$comment: Content for the gameplay-v2 end-to-end test ONLY, passed with --content-dir.
Deliberately NOT added to backend/content/items.json: the game has no abilities
yet, and a test that needs one must not decide what the game ships. Keeping it
here also means the assertions below can pin exact numbers without a content
change silently rewriting what the test proves.
bolt: entity-targeted damage. power 20 on top of the caster's attack, before the
target's defense. Range 10 comfortably exceeds the 3.0 basic-attack range, so an
out-of-range refusal here would be a real failure rather than a positioning
accident. cooldownTicks 5 at 15 Hz is a third of a second.
